variants.name: reference
variants.says: Cartesian grid at 10.5 points per wavelength, rails every 8 cm read from 2 positions, low response 1.2 s, 100 000 rays

variants.name: grid-7.2
variants.says: the wave grid at 7.2 points per wavelength: a solve three times cheaper, more dispersion towards 1.5 kHz

variants.name: rail-10cm-x8
variants.says: rails solved every 10 cm, a moving source read from 8 positions weighted per frequency

variants.name: rail-12cm-x8
variants.says: rails solved every 12 cm, read from 8 positions: half a wavelength at 1.4 kHz, where the low mask ends

variants.name: low-0.8s
variants.says: the low band solved for 0.8 s and faded to nothing over its last 20 ms

variants.name: rays-50k
variants.says: a tail site casts 50 000 rays: the same energy, read with more noise

variants.name: all-cheap
variants.says: 7.2 points per wavelength, rails every 12 cm read from 8 positions, low response 0.8 s
